department: College of Engineering and Polymer Science (interdisciplinary Engineering, PhD)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

entry_route.value: Applicants can hold a bachelor's degree in engineering or a master's degree with an equivalent engineering background.
entry_route.quote: Applicants for the Doctor of Philosophy in Engineering must hold a bachelor’s degree | Applicants with a Master of Science degree must provide satisfactory evidence of an equivalent engineering baccalaureate background

notes: Interdisciplinary PhD in Engineering, run through home departments in ECE, mechanical, chemical, civil and biomedical engineering; the student chooses the home department. Admission also needs three letters of recommendation, a statement of purpose and a resume. Bachelor's degrees must be from an ABET-accredited program, with bridge-up coursework for other disciplines.
